en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4342 - It is narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Abdillah (as), that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Whoever gets married has safeguarded half of his religion."
In another narration, it is added: "So let him fear Allah (swt) regarding the remaining half."
